representative samples used for PTQ, on local disk
• One pip-installable package: pip install mctk
• No server process, no client-server split
• Runs entirely on the user's machine — CLI, notebook, or CI step
✓ Separated in code — one Python subpackage per module
✓ Communication is in-process function calls only, no network hops
✗ Not split into microservices — a single-machine run doesn't need one
